status: design only; no product edits or test reruns
recommendation: Use bounded typed evidence and obligation protocols before adding learned complexity.

closure_map.improvement: Deterministic constraint reducer preserves each assessment polarity, scope, citation set and assessor. Unsupported auditor failure becomes unknown/contested. Demonstrated failure needs accepted adverse basis.
acceptance: Positive synthesis citation cannot become support for adverse audit verdict.
All-options-infeasible requires an accepted adverse hard-requirement basis for every option.
Exact arithmetic governs numeric comparison but retains factual-input qualifications.

closure_map.improvement: Allocate bounded search/page opportunities across comparison, cost and counterevidence objectives before consuming the first result queue. Record objective shortfalls; avoid search spending with no usable page/context capacity.
acceptance: Eight first-query hits cannot starve reserved counterevidence or cost acquisition.
All unavailable or unfinished objectives remain visible.
Existing six-query/eight-page/24-passage and original spending/deadline ceilings hold.

closure_map.improvement: Immutable proposition-specific supports/refutes/context assessments and an explicit claim-state reducer. AND required premises, OR alternative sufficient bases; preserve contradicted/stale ancestors and require explicit resolution.
acceptance: An identical claim cannot become supported solely through a contradicted ancestor.
A genuinely opposite proposition can cite a refutation with explicit relation polarity.
Cyclic justification, missing required premises, stale support and wrong scope cannot qualify.

closure_map.improvement: Immutable objection/resolution ledger with stable targets and server-derived pending obligations. Later stages must address existing material IDs; omissions stay open. Display critical/material unresolved concerns before bounded optional dissent; link overflow.
acceptance: More than20 earlier objections cannot displace final-audit critical findings.
A proposal material concern cannot disappear merely because synthesis/audit omits it.
Answers require a valid resolution receipt; changed evidence reopens dependent resolutions.

closure_map.improvement: Scoped cost/requirement assessment and attestation records replace global source-status promotion. Frozen policy specifies acceptable basis types; readiness exposes input completeness, arithmetic, feasibility support, review coverage, objections and freshness independently.
acceptance: Specific verified/attested fields qualify only for their declared scope and policy.
User attestation never becomes independent verification; model agreement alone never qualifies.
Expired, unmatched or incomplete quotes remain conditional with explicit next action.

closure_map.improvement: Canonical offset-preserving paragraph windows, requirement-aware lexical ranking, targeted exception search and bounded greedy objective/source-diversity coverage. Expose selected intervals and omitted coverage.
acceptance: Late decisive exclusions are retrieved under the same token/page budget.
Every passage reproduces the exact saved source span/hash.
Retrieval recall measures both support and counterevidence on unseen labeled cases.

uncertainty_semantics.meaning: Attributed evidence/workflow states under a frozen policy, not probabilities or guarantees of real-world truth.
prohibitions: No numerical confidence without empirical calibration.
No assumption that provider diversity proves independent errors.
No automatic source verification from rereading or agreement.

complexity.claim_graph: O(V+E), affected-subgraph incremental recomputation; bounded current claim/reference limits.
complexity.objection_ledger: O(objections+events), stable target indexes and bounded display with explicit overflow.
complexity.retrieval: O(B+P*R+K*P) bounded by capped fetched bytes, candidate windows, <=20 requirements and <=24 selected passages; no mandatory new model calls.

rollout: A: deterministic report/citation fixes, objection display preservation, objective fetch reservations.
B: immutable assessments/obligations and versioned reducers computed in shadow mode.
C: obligation-carrying review and scoped attestation; publication reducer switched after reviewed acceptance.
D: evaluated requirement-aware passage ranking; learned reranking optional only after held-out advantage.
historical_reports: Keep original algorithm/policy versions; do not silently relabel historical conclusions.
